best_hook.why: Woman in gold tells the bride in white, at the altar, 'Because he is marrying me' - instant betrayal reveal a stranger gets in two seconds.

best_cliffhanger.why: Jilted bride's tears harden into cold defiance under an ominous swell - viewer wants to see her revenge.

must_promos.why: Opens on the sister claiming the groom, runs through 'I changed my mind' and the sister's gloating, and cuts on 'he was never going to marry you' - pure altar betrayal.
Starts on the venomous 'daughter people tolerate' line, groom calls her plain and worthless, and ends on her face turning to cold resolve - humiliation into implied revenge.

standalone_risk: The gold-gowned woman is only identified as her sister by one 'sister' line; the matriarch's relation to Juliana is never stated; nothing hints at the soldier/duke premise of the title.
